item.title: With Sophia Stepping Back From KATSEYE, Will the Global Girl Group Remain a Quartet?
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to the Billboard Pop Shop Podcast. I'm Katie, and I'm here with Keith. Today, we're discussing the latest news in the world of pop.
Keith: That's right, Katie. We've got some big updates to share. KATSEYE, the global girl group, just announced that Sophia is taking a step back to prioritize her mental health and wellness. This comes after a similar announcement from groupmate Manon back in February.
Katie: That's right. The group is now down to a quartet, and it's unclear when either member might return. This news comes at a busy time for KATSEYE, with their new album "Wild" out now and their "Wildworld Tour" kicking off in October.
Keith: We're also looking at the latest chart news. Ariana Grande's new album "petal" has debuted atop the Billboard 200 chart, with the title track landing in the top five on the Billboard Hot 100 songs chart.
Katie: And Ella Langley's "Choosin' Texas" is still going strong, holding the top spot for a 17th week. We'll be discussing all of this and more on today's show.
[Outro music plays]
Host: Thanks for tuning in to the Billboard Pop Shop Podcast. You can stream us on Billboard.com or download us on Apple Podcasts or your favorite podcast provider. We'll catch you next time.
